name: last call
source:
In the back-office of a small beer shop that is about to close, the owner's cat is napping the evening away, unaware of the tragedy around her.

And in her dream, the essence of memory and humanity unfolds through an unexpected meeting and a radical change.

[From [url=https://rinkaku.itch.io/last-call]itch.io[/url]]
translation:
在一家即将关门的小啤酒店的后台，店主的猫正在午睡，没有意识到周围发生的悲剧。

在她的梦中，记忆和人性的本质通过一次意外的相遇和彻底的改变而展开。

[来自[url=https://rinkaku.itch.io/last-call]itch.io[/url]]
